## CORE RULE 3. No sexual content, including erotic roleplay (ERP) and no shock content.
This is a zero tolerance rule and is strictly enforced.
This community is 16+ which means we have to protect minors. Sexual content and themes are not allowed, including direct or indirect mentions of sexual behavior and actions. Additionally, in-character romantic relationships should not become the focus of the game for you or anyone else involved.
Any words or actions that are either intended or likely to be seriously disturbing to others are considered shock content and not allowed. That includes but isn’t limited to descriptive text depicting extreme gore, mutilation or defecation.
